_comment: Structural (market-structure) exits beyond SL/TP/EOD. Evaluated on the UNDERLYING OHLCV so a trade that went into profit but is reversing is closed before it round-trips to the stop. Each family is independently toggleable. Structural exits only ARM once the trade is in profit by arm_profit_pct (protect gains; never choke a fresh entry). Hard SL/target are unchanged. Edit here — no hard-coding in code.
